caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, resembling a candlestick or lamp, set against a plain, off-white background framed by a thin red border. The object has a broad, circular base that appears dark gray or black with shading to indicate depth. From the base, a tiered and elaborately turned stem rises vertically, with multiple curves and flares leading up to a bulbous central body. Attached to the right side of the stem is a single, ornate handle that curves outward and then back toward the central form, ending in a tight spiral. At the top of the bulbous body is a gold or brass-colored cylindrical cap from which extends a straight, narrow rod of the same color, vertically upward and centered. The drawing uses varied shading to suggest the metallic texture and three-dimensional shape of the object.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
